name: writing-plugins
description: Read this before authoring or substantially changing a plugin, skill, or agent for Archie. It's the conceptual playbook for building plugins that fit Archie's one-agent-per-task model — what a plugin contributes, when a skill is the right answer (almost always), and the narrow cases where a worker earns a definition file. Triggers on "write a plugin", "add a skill", "add an agent", "create a new domain". This is the "how to think about it" layer; the README's Plugins section and docs/architecture/plugin-system.md are the "how to wire it up" layer.
